name: UP3X1 Premium v2M
summary: This EA implements a trend-following strategy using multiple moving average confirmations and momentum filters to identify and ride strong directional moves. It enters positions when short-term momentum aligns with longer-term trend direction, with built-in trailing stop management. The system targets sustained trends across multiple timeframes for optimal entry timing.
summary_zh: 该EA采用基于多重均线确认和动量过滤器的趋势跟踪策略，识别并跟随强势方向性行情。当短期动量与长期趋势方向一致时入场，并内置移动止损管理。系统在多周期上瞄准持续趋势以获得最优入场时机。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是趋势跟踪，通过多重均线系统判断市场主趋势方向。入场条件依赖短期均线与长期均线的交叉或排列关系，同时结合动量指标（如RSI或MACD）确认趋势强度，避免在震荡市中频繁开仓。出场条件包括固定止损、移动止损和趋势反转信号触发平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式，未发现明显的马丁格尔或网格加仓逻辑。资金管理方面，EA设置了最大持仓限制和单笔风险控制，但缺少对冲机制来应对极端行情。整体策略逻辑清晰，适合在有明显趋势的市场中运行，但在震荡行情中可能产生连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following, utilizing a multiple moving average system to determine the prevailing market direction. Entry conditions rely on the crossover or alignment relationship between short-term and long-term moving averages, combined with momentum indicators (such as RSI or MACD) to confirm trend strength and avoid frequent entries in ranging markets. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss, trailing stop management, and position closure triggered by trend reversal signals. Position sizing adopts either fixed lot sizes or percentage-based calculations tied to account balance, with no evident martingale or grid position-adding logic. Money management features include maximum position limits and per-trade risk controls, but lacks hedging mechanisms to handle extreme market conditions. The overall strategy logic is clear and well-suited for trending markets, but may generate consecutive losses during choppy or sideways periods.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying this EA's orders

pros: 多重均线确认机制有效过滤假信号，提高入场质量
内置移动止损功能锁定盈利，减少回吐风险
趋势跟踪策略逻辑清晰，适合趋势行情中获取较大利润
参数可配置性强，用户可根据不同品种和时间框架调整
有魔术编号管理，支持多EA同账户运行
pros_en: Multiple MA confirmation effectively filters false signals and improves entry quality
Built-in trailing stop locks in profits and reduces drawdown risk
Clear trend-following logic excels in trending markets for capturing large moves
Highly configurable parameters allow adaptation to different instruments and timeframes
Magic number management enables multiple EAs on the same account
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡行情中容易产生连续亏损
缺少震荡市过滤器，可能在横盘期间频繁开仓平仓
止损设置相对简单，未考虑ATR动态止损
没有新闻事件过滤功能，重大数据发布时风险较大
缺少多时间框架确认，可能逆大势交易
cons_en: Trend-following strategy prone to consecutive losses in ranging/choppy markets
Lacks range market filter, may frequently open and close positions during sideways periods
Stop loss is relatively simplistic without ATR-based dynamic stops
No news event filter, exposing positions to high risk during major data releases
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, potentially trading against higher timeframe trend
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损替代固定点数止损，适应不同市场波动率
添加震荡市过滤器（如ADX或布林带宽度），在横盘时减少交易频率
增加多时间框架趋势确认，确保交易方向与大周期一致
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss to replace fixed pip stops, adapting to varying market volatility
Implement range market filter (e.g., ADX or Bollinger Band width) to reduce trading frequency during sideways markets
Add multi-timeframe trend confirmation to ensure trade direction aligns with higher timeframe trend

risk_points: 固定止损未考虑市场波动率变化，低波动时止损过宽高波动时过窄
缺少震荡市识别机制，横盘行情中可能连续触发止损
无新闻事件过滤，重大数据发布时可能遭遇滑点扩大
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss doesn't account for volatility changes - too wide in low volatility, too narrow in high volatility
No range market identification, consecutive stop losses possible during sideways periods
No news event filter, exposed to increased slippage during major data releases
